plugins.name: cmux-workflow
plugins.description: Run parallel coding agents as cmux panes and actually know when they finish. Dispatch codex/grok/claude lanes with briefs that survive, watch them via cmux's own turn-hook session store (`agentLifecycle: idle` — a recorded fact, not a `pgrep` guess), survive conversation compact by pinning a self-invoke block into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, audit lanes you forgot to watch, and clean them up safely. Runs in Claude Code, codex and grok. Ships `/cmux-workflow:lanes`, `/cmux-workflow:setup`, plus `lane-status.sh` and `lane-watch.sh`.
